feature: Tag with name, plus TagAssignment connecting tags to products

entities.name: Tag
invariants: name is unique across all tags

entities.name: TagAssignment
invariants: (tag_id, product_id) pair is unique — a tag can only be assigned once per product
tag_id must reference an existing Tag
product_id must reference an existing Product

entities.name: Product
entities.note: Already defined as sqlalchemy_model in fastapi-shop codebase graph

imports: Base from models (per existing model_base contract)

notes: Extractor demoted: 'Name' was treated as a top-level entity by the rule-based extractor; it is actually a scalar attribute of Tag.
Extractor renamed: 'TagassignmentConnectingTagsToProduct' collapsed to clean entity 'TagAssignment'.

Extractor relationship fix: the raw 'has_many' edge between Tag and TagAssignment is correct as one half of the join, but the user's intent ('connecting tags to products') is a many-to-many between Tag and Product realized through TagAssignment — that is the primary relationship.
Product is reused from the existing fastapi-shop codebase (sqlalchemy_model already present).
